story2.title: Tinku (beginner)
pages: Tinku the little fox found a little under the old tree.
She showed the little to her friend, a river who lived by the river.
Together they walked to the basket to find out who lost it.
The river said the basket was too far, but Tinku kept going.
At sunset they found the owner, and everyone shared a little and laughed.
